Read the complete required authored units, exact selected declarations/implementation/tests and policy; shared identical inputs were read once across packets. rationale: Comparison for unit:shared.typing.types against lean:Shared/TypingViews:Perm, lean:Shared/TypingViews:Nominal, lean:Shared/TypingViews:RawType, lean:Shared/TypingViews:ValueType.whole. Perm has given/shared and RawType has nominal/application, matching nested surface permissions. Nominal reuses Given ViewType and ValueType.whole uses a positive root view. This is syntax; nominal-kind admissibility is supplied later, so the grammar itself need not exclude all invalid class permissions. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:given.typing.views.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent fresh reviewer.

Lean checks proof correctness separately. Tooling review checks implementation and finite test coverage, not universal correctness or browser/CDN behavior. Additional context keys identify supporting definitions inspected in those files, not an audit of every proof or line.
